name: Lichtenberg Wood Burn
promptTemplate: Lichtenberg electrical tree burning into {{wood_type}} plank with {{voltage}} current, branching density {{branch_density}}, grain bias {{grain_bias}}, glowing with {{glow_intensity}} intensity and {{spark_count}}, smoke trails {{smoke_trails}}

wood_type.hint: Swaps plank and ignites fresh electrodes

voltage.hint: Drives burn speed and branching violence

branch_density.hint: Cap on simultaneous burning lead tendrils

grain_bias.hint: How rigidly electrical paths follow wood grain

glow_intensity.hint: Boosts neon orange bloom at arc heads

listing.blurb: Branching high-voltage arcs creep across a wooden plank, leaving carbon fractures and glowing embers until the board chars through.
listing.prompt: A Lichtenberg figure burning into wood: a branching electrical tree creeps outward across a plank, glowing orange at its tips and charring black behind, until the whole plank is covered and a new one slides in. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
